creator: Alexander Terp
description:
For skill command includes, `TAI_MANIFEST_DIR` is the skill's source directory (SPEC.md's env table for includes). For post_install steps it is tai's manifest directory (`~/.config/tai/manifests`). One name for two unrelated paths invites a script written for one context to read the wrong directory in the other. Rename one of them (keeping the old name as an alias for a release, with a warning in the docs), and state each variable's meaning in one env-var reference.

Related: `TAI_SOURCE_DIR` (post_install, a path) vs `TAI_SOURCE` (command sources, a source name) are also close; the docs now state the difference.
title: TAI_MANIFEST_DIR means two unrelated paths
